description:
Cheapest one-way fares for a route, by day, with airline, stops and a skyfarenet.com link.

        Use for questions like "cheapest Lahore to Jeddah flight in November" or "Dubai to Islamabad ticket price".
        origin and destination: a city name (Lahore, Dubai, Madinah, Buraydah), a 3-letter airport code (LHE, DXB),
        or a country (Canada, UK, USA, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Italy...), which compares every airport we cover there.
        month: optional, "YYYY-MM"; by default this month and next. Prices are in PKR.
name: search_fares
title: Search fares on a route
